name: Sajóecseg (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sajóecseg: a blue shield with a red-clad figure, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
